purpose: Save a dated Federal Reserve press-feed brief with explicit synthetic, saved-input or fetched provenance and visible source gaps.
access: Python 3.11+ and the full Lab checkout. Default and saved-input modes are offline. Explicit --fetch uses one unauthenticated request to the fixed public Board feed; no credentials, Kit or model.
cost: Local compute by default. Explicit fetching adds ordinary network access with no paid API, model or trading calls.

sources.license: Board public-domain default unless otherwise indicated; non-Board material and protected seals/logos require separate review; attribute the Board without implying endorsement.
